verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs clearly describe RBAC: assigning roles to users and permissions to roles for authorization (auth0-docs-7, auth0-docs-39, auth0-docs-45), which is the core of the story. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of enforcement mechanics or how permissions/roles are surfaced as claims inside access/ID tokens for downstream authorization checks. Missing for 10: documentation on enabling 'Add Permissions in the Access Token' setting, token claim structure (e.g., custom namespace claims), and enforcement examples via Rules/Actions or API scope checks.
